_note: Researched return weeks for rostered players. return_week = first NFL week the player is expected to play. Maintained by the morning report run. NFL IR = minimum 4 games.

A.J. Brown.note: Knee flare-up on top of the ankle; has missed the last two games. Listed Questionable for Week 10 and expected to travel to Munich, but the beat reporting says he likely will not play and is expected to be held out through the Week 11 bye, returning Week 12 at LAC. The 11/10 Sleeper move from Out to Questionable is a designation change only. Unconfirmed.
A.J. Brown.source: ESPN (Schefter, knee is the primary concern); ProFootballRumors (11/2026); Musketfire (Vrabel: likely will not make it); NFL.com 2026 Patriots schedule (Week 11 bye)

Isiah Pacheco.note: Back surgery to remove a body pressing on a nerve; 12-week recovery with a chance he's back early December (Rapoport). Replaces the old IR-minimum Week 5 estimate. Not currently rostered in this league.
Isiah Pacheco.source: Ian Rapoport (NFL Network), ESPN, Pro Football Rumors

Jordyn Tyson.note: IR (designated to return), right hamstring. Reports 11/2 say he could debut Week 9 vs CLE (Nov 8) after the Saints bye. Unconfirmed until he's activated.
Jordyn Tyson.source: Yahoo Sports / Heavy (11/2), Adam Schefter (ESPN) earlier

De'Von Achane.note: Torn ACL in Week 3 loss to KC, confirmed by MRI Monday; placed on IR. Out for the season.

Travis Etienne.note: IR, hamstring (Week 3). Eligible Week 9 vs CLE (Nov 8) after the Saints bye. As of 11/2 Moore was evaluating him Monday and the team hadn't decided whether to open his 21-day practice window this week. Week 9 still possible, unconfirmed.
Travis Etienne.source: Kellen Moore via NBC Sports, CBS Sports (11/2)

Breece Hall.note: Quad; missed five straight (through Week 8 vs LV). Rapoport (11/2): considered 'good to go', expected back Week 9 vs KC. Glenn: 'he's close', handling it carefully; workload may be limited with Braelon Allen involved.
Breece Hall.source: Ian Rapoport (NFL Network) via RotoWire; Aaron Glenn via NBC Sports (11/2)

Lamar Jackson.note: Right thumb injury on Baltimore's first offensive play of Week 8 vs BUF (first game back from the ankle). Minter: needs surgery and goes on IR, so he misses at least Weeks 9-12. Minter didn't know yet if it's season-ending; Week 13 is the earliest possible return.
Lamar Jackson.source: Jesse Minter via ESPN, Yahoo Sports, BaltimoreRavens.com (11/1)

DeVonta Smith.note: Hamstring setbacks: sidelined since Week 6, ruled out Weeks 7, 8 and 9. Not on NFL IR. Eagles bye is Week 10, so Week 11 is the earliest possible game; a report says not back until at least Week 11. Unconfirmed.
DeVonta Smith.source: The Fantasy Footballers (Week 9 'won't play Sunday'), FantasyPros, NBC Sports (PFT)

Kyle Monangai.note: Turf toe (plus thumb), out since Week 4; still Out for Week 9 (Sleeper status Out, 0 pts). Bears kept him off IR. Bears bye is Week 10, so Week 11 is the earliest possible game. Unconfirmed.

TreVeyon Henderson.note: Neurological symptoms that required hospitalisation; has not practised at all in November and is out for Week 10 at DET (Munich). Sleeper moved him Out -> Questionable on 11/10 but the reporting says he is not playing, so the designation is not a return signal. Patriots bye is Week 11, so Week 12 at LAC is the earliest possible game. No timetable given - unconfirmed.
TreVeyon Henderson.source: NBC Sports Week 10 injury report (11/10); RotoBaller Corey Kiner player news (11/09); NFL.com/Patriots.com 2026 schedule (Week 11 bye)

Deebo Samuel.note: Right hamstring strain, hurt Week 5 vs SEA. Shanahan: strained it 'pretty good', will miss 'at least a couple weeks'; MRI confirmed a multi-week absence. Out Week 6 vs WAS and Week 7 at ATL; 49ers bye is Week 8, so Week 9 is the earliest realistic return.

Jalen Hurts.note: Superficial blood clot in calf (cleated Week 4 vs LAR); out since Week 5, still on IR per Sleeper status (11/10). Eagles bye is Week 10 (NFL.com schedule), so Week 11 is the earliest possible game. No 2026 activation report found. Unconfirmed.
Jalen Hurts.source: Eagles statement via ESPN/Philadelphia Inquirer (10/15); Sleeper status IR (11/10); NFL.com 2026 Eagles schedule (Week 10 bye)

David Montgomery.note: Groin (hurt 10/11 at TEN). Hasn't practiced since; Ryans: week-to-week, ruled out Week 9 vs LAC after some progress. Not on NFL IR. Week 10 is the next game, unconfirmed. Woody Marks leads the backfield.
David Montgomery.source: DeMeco Ryans via The Fantasy Footballers, Newsweek, ClutchPoints

RJ Harvey.note: Short-term IR 10/31 (knee, hurt in practice 10/29). Must miss four games: Weeks 8, 9, 11, 12 (DEN bye Week 10). Eligible Week 13 vs MIA.
RJ Harvey.source: AP via Washington Post/Fox Sports, NBC Sports (PFT), Yahoo (11/1)

Rhamondre Stevenson.note: Knee tendon injury suffered in the Week 9 loss to GB; ruled out for Week 10 at DET and reported as a multi-week absence. Patriots bye is Week 11, so Week 12 at LAC is the earliest possible game. Sleeper has him Doubtful. Unconfirmed.
Rhamondre Stevenson.source: NBC Sports Week 10 injury report (11/10); NESN (11/10); NFL.com/Patriots.com 2026 schedule (Week 11 bye)
